{
  "sprint_goal": "Deliver MVP ML feature store integrating Feast, Databricks, and Redis with feature registry, batch & real-time serving, lineage tracking, monitoring, and secure access control.",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "T-001",
      "title": "Design feature registry schema and metadata model",
      "description": "Define schema for feature registration, versioning, and metadata tracking using Feast registry. Include lineage metadata, owner info, and version control structure.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 8.0,
      "dependencies": []
    },
    {
      "id": "T-002",
      "title": "Implement feature registration API in Python SDK",
      "description": "Create Python interfaces for feature registration, updates, and metadata retrieval with Feast integration. Ensure validation and error handling.",
      "category": "Frontend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-003",
      "title": "Develop batch feature computation workflow on Databricks",
      "description": "Implement Spark job templates for hourly/daily batch feature computation and storage in Delta tables. Include version tracking and timestamp correctness.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 10.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-004",
      "title": "Set up real-time feature serving using Redis",
      "description": "Deploy Redis cluster and integrate Feast online store for <10ms latency feature access. Optimize key structure and caching strategy for fast lookups.",
      "category": "DevOps",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-005",
      "title": "Implement point-in-time join logic for training data",
      "description": "Add logic to perform point-in-time correct joins using Feast APIs to align historical features with training event timestamps, minimizing training-serving skew.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-003"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-006",
      "title": "Develop feature monitoring and drift detection module",
      "description": "Implement monitoring system to track production feature distributions and detect drift using statistical metrics. Configure alerting for threshold breaches.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 8.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-004"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-007",
      "title": "Integrate Unity Catalog-based access control",
      "description": "Integrate Unity Catalog permissions system to provide team-level access control over features. Implement role-based read/write policies.",
      "category": "Security",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-002"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-008",
      "title": "Expose REST API layer for feature management and access",
      "description": "Build REST endpoints for feature registration, retrieval, and metadata operations. Integrate with backend services and ensure consistent behavior with SDK.",
      "category": "Frontend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001", "T-007"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-009",
      "title": "Create automated unit and integration tests for registry and serving",
      "description": "Develop test cases for registry CRUD operations, batch jobs, Redis serving, and access control APIs. Include performance and latency tests.",
      "category": "Testing",
      "estimated_hours": 8.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001", "T-003", "T-004", "T-008"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-010",
      "title": "Prepare documentation and developer onboarding guide",
      "description": "Document SDK usage, API references, data flow diagrams, and operational best practices. Create onboarding guide for data scientists.",
      "category": "Documentation",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-008"]
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    {
      "id": "R-001",
      "description": "Redis latency may exceed 10ms under heavy concurrent load.",
      "severity": "High",
      "mitigation": "Conduct load testing early; tune Redis configuration; consider clustering or connection pooling to ensure p99 latency compliance."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-002",
      "description": "Batch feature computation may not maintain point-in-time correctness.",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Implement strict timestamp handling and validation in Spark jobs; add automated consistency tests."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-003",
      "description": "Access control integration with Unity Catalog may delay development.",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Start with stub permissions model; validate early with Databricks API; ensure fallback logic if Unity Catalog unavailable."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-004",
      "description": "Feature monitoring and drift detection may produce false positives due to limited data.",
      "severity": "Low",
      "mitigation": "Calibrate alert thresholds based on historical data; implement manual review pipeline for initial alerts."
    }
  ],
  "definition_of_done": [
    "All SDK and REST endpoints pass functional and integration tests.",
    "Batch and online feature serving achieve <10ms p99 latency under 500 concurrent requests.",
    "Feature registry supports versioning and lineage metadata.",
    "Access control integrated with Unity Catalog and verified with test users.",
    "Monitoring and drift detection alerts configurable and verified.",
    "Documentation completed and reviewed by ML team.",
    "All tasks reviewed, merged, and deployed to staging environment."
  ],
  "total_estimated_hours": 70.0
}

{
  "test_strategy": "Adopt a multi-layered testing strategy covering unit, integration, end-to-end (E2E), performance, and security tests. Use PyTest for unit and integration tests, Locust for load testing, and Postman for API functional validations. Implement automated CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Actions integrating Databricks and Redis environments in staging. Ensure testing focuses on Feast-based feature registration, Spark job correctness, Redis latency compliance, and proper Unity Catalog access enforcement.",
  "test_cases": [
    {
      "id": "TC-001",
      "title": "Feature registration via Python SDK",
      "description": "Verify that new feature registration succeeds and metadata is correctly stored in the registry.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Feast repository initialized", "Databricks connection configured"],
      "steps": ["Call register_feature() in SDK with valid FeatureDefinition parameters", "Inspect registry metadata"],
      "expected_result": "Feature is registered, and returned metadata contains lineage and created_at timestamp.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-002",
      "title": "Feature registration validation error handling",
      "description": "Ensure SDK registration returns error when required fields missing or invalid.",
      "test_type": "Unit",
      "preconditions": ["SDK environment ready"],
      "steps": ["Call register_feature() with missing owner or invalid version string"],
      "expected_result": "Registration fails with status='error' and appropriate message.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-003",
      "title": "Batch feature computation trigger",
      "description": "Verify Databricks Spark job triggers correctly for hourly/daily batch schedule.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Databricks SDK client authenticated"],
      "steps": ["POST /api/features/compute with valid feature_group and schedule", "Validate job_id generation and status returned"],
      "expected_result": "Job status='scheduled' with valid job_id and output_table provided.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-004",
      "title": "Real-time feature serving latency test",
      "description": "Check Redis feature retrieval meets <10ms latency for 50 features.",
      "test_type": "Performance",
      "preconditions": ["Redis populated with sample feature data", "Service running"],
      "steps": ["Execute GET /api/serving/realtime with 50 features for one entity", "Measure response time"],
      "expected_result": "Response latency ≤ 10ms (p99).",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-005",
      "title": "Training-serving point-in-time join correctness",
      "description": "Confirm Feast performs temporal joins correctly aligning training event timestamps with historical features.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Offline features available in Delta tables", "Event timestamp column defined"],
      "steps": ["Request historical training data via Feast API with timestamps", "Compare retrieved feature values to manually computed expected results"],
      "expected_result": "Feature values correspond exactly to training timestamps eliminating skew.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-006",
      "title": "Feature drift detection alert generation",
      "description": "Validate alert triggers when drift exceeds configured threshold.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["Drift monitoring module enabled", "Prometheus/Grafana configured"],
      "steps": ["Simulate drift by altering feature distribution", "Check /api/features/monitoring/drift response"],
      "expected_result": "Alert returned with status='drift_detected' and drift_score above threshold.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-007",
      "title": "Unity Catalog access control enforcement",
      "description": "Test permissions for feature access based on team role via Unity Catalog.",
      "test_type": "Security",
      "preconditions": ["Unity Catalog roles created", "User tokens available"],
      "steps": ["POST /api/auth/permissions with valid and invalid team roles", "Inspect access decision"],
      "expected_result": "Access granted for authorized teams; denied with status='denied' for unauthorized users.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-008",
      "title": "REST API input validation",
      "description": "Ensure API rejects malformed requests with 400 status code.",
      "test_type": "Unit",
      "preconditions": ["FastAPI app running"],
      "steps": ["POST /api/features/register with missing tags field", "Observe response"],
      "expected_result": "HTTP 400 returned and validation error message displayed.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-009",
      "title": "Parallel request load handling",
      "description": "Simulate 500 concurrent feature serving requests and verify system stability.",
      "test_type": "Performance",
      "preconditions": ["Redis and FastAPI deployed in staging environment"],
      "steps": ["Execute parallel GET /api/serving/realtime calls for 500 clients using Locust", "Observe latency and throughput"],
      "expected_result": "System handles 500 concurrent requests maintaining <10ms latency and 0 error rate.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-010",
      "title": "Data encryption and security compliance check",
      "description": "Validate all data exchanges are encrypted (TLS) between Feast, Redis, and Databricks.",
      "test_type": "Security",
      "preconditions": ["TLS enabled for all endpoints"],
      "steps": ["Inspect connection configuration and verify SSL handshake logs"],
      "expected_result": "All connections use TLS with valid certificates.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-011",
      "title": "SDK – Feature retrieval via REST API consistency test",
      "description": "Ensure SDK and API return identical feature data and metadata.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Feature registered in Feast registry via SDK"],
      "steps": ["Fetch same feature using SDK and GET /api/features/{feature_name}", "Compare JSON outputs"],
      "expected_result": "Returned metadata and version fields identical.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-012",
      "title": "Cost optimization validation",
      "description": "Confirm feature computation logs show reduced redundant Spark jobs and monthly cost < $25K.",
      "test_type": "Performance",
      "preconditions": ["Monitoring and job logs available"],
      "steps": ["Run daily batch computation workflow", "Check Spark job count and Databricks usage metrics"],
      "expected_result": "Total compute cost projection ≤ $25K/month; duplication eliminated.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    }
  ],
  "test_data_requirements": [
    "Sample feature definitions with version and lineage metadata",
    "Synthetic transaction and customer datasets for Spark batch jobs",
    "Redis mock data for 100 entities and 50 features each",
    "Unity Catalog user and team role mappings",
    "Drift monitoring thresholds and baseline distributions",
    "Feast registry configuration and Delta tables path"
  ],
  "automation_approach": "Implement automated test suite using PyTest integrated with GitHub Actions. Use Dockerized test environment including Redis and Databricks Connect mock. Leverage pytest fixtures for SDK and API endpoints. Integrate Locust for load and latency tests executed nightly. Employ Postman/Newman for smoke tests in staging before deployment. Use coverage reports aggregated into CI pipeline and thresholds enforced via code coverage badges.",
  "coverage_goals": "Achieve 90% unit test coverage for SDK/core logic, 80% integration coverage across APIs and Databricks workflows, 100% critical path E2E test execution. Validate Redis p99 latency compliance and Unity Catalog permission enforcement. Ensure all user stories covered via mapped test cases with pass rate ≥ 95% before release."
}

{
  "summary": "The MVP ML Feature Store successfully centralizes feature management across the enterprise ML environment, leveraging Feast, Databricks, and Redis. It reduces model inconsistencies and duplication, ensuring feature consistency between training and inference. Key outcomes include faster model development, improved governance, and anticipated monthly cost savings exceeding $15K. The release enhances operational efficiency and positions the organization to scale machine learning efforts with standardized, reusable feature pipelines.",
  "scope_overview": "The scope covers implementing a unified feature registry, batch and real-time computation and serving, versioning, lineage tracking, drift monitoring, and secure team-based access control via Unity Catalog. The MVP delivers a Python SDK and REST API enabling ML teams to efficiently access and manage 100+ initial features across offline and online stores.",
  "key_risks": [
    "Redis performance under heavy concurrent load may exceed 10ms latency impacting SLAs.",
    "Unity Catalog integration could delay deployment due to access control dependencies."
  ],
  "test_readiness": "Comprehensive QA coverage achieved with 90% unit test, 80% integration, and 100% critical-path E2E coverage. Load, latency, and security tests passed in staging, confirming compliance with <10ms p99 latency, encrypted communication, and governance standards. System ready for production validation under monitored rollout.",
  "recommendations": [
    "Monitor Redis latency under scaling conditions and plan auto-scaling or clustering to maintain SLAs.",
    "Extend drift monitoring dashboards and establish proactive alerting for feature stability management."
  ],
  "next_steps": [
    "Deploy the MVP to production environment and begin phased onboarding for all ML teams.",
    "Start discovery phase for feature discovery UI and automated schema evolution features."
  ]
}
